The Devil Wears Prada 2 | Streaming on Disney+ and Hulu July 29
Fashion's finest sequel. The Devil Wears Prada 2 is streaming on Disney+ and Hulu July 29.

Celebrate the box office smash, which took the worlds of fashion and media by storm when it opened in theaters this past May, on its way to grossing more than $677 million worldwide. “The Devil Wears Prada” franchise recently crossed the $1 billion mark. From Dior, Versace, Armani, Givenchy, and Cartier to Dolce, Tiffany, and Fendi, the film features avant-garde fashions and is packed with celebrity cameos and luminaries from the worlds of fashion and music.
 
The sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation stars Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci, and is directed by David Frankel, written by Aline Brosh McKenna, produced by Wendy Finerman, and executive produced by Michael Bederman, Karen Rosenfelt, and Aline Brosh McKenna.
